 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNISH BHATNAGAR  OR % 19.05.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of 1.
This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No.243/2022, under Section 376(2)(F) IPC, registered at Police Station Lodhi Road, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. It is submitted by the counsel for the petitioner that the present FIR is nothing but a ploy to extort money from the petitioner.
He further submitted that respondent no.2/victim has even issued false and fabricated legal notice This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 16:51:23 dated 25.05.2022 demanding Rs.54,000/- in lieu of her salary which was also paid by the petitioner in cash.

He further submitted that according to the respondent/victim the incident took place on 16.01.2022 and 17.01.2022, and FIR was registered after a period of 11 months, and there is no explanation regarding the delay in lodging of the FIR.
He further submitted that there was not even a whisper of rape in the legal notice which was issued by respondent no.2 through her lawyer.
3. Issue notice.
Learned APP appears on advance notice, and accepts notice.
She seeks time to file the status report.
